subcategory_text: Sign model artefacts at release, publish hashes and provenance attestations, and provide a verification mechanism for downstream consumers.
implementation_examples: Sign model artefacts with a hardened key (HSM-backed where possible)
Publish model cards with hashes and training-data references
Provide a verification command or attestation API
assessment_objectives: Determine whether model artefacts are signed at release.
Determine whether consumers can verify integrity before use.
